An example: ```scala import scalaz.std.anyVal._ import scalaz.stream._ import scalaz.stream.parsers._ import Parser._ // returns the depth of parentheses nesting lazy val parens: Parser[Char, Int] = ( '(' ~> parens <~ ')' ^^ (1 +) | completed(0) ) Process("((()))()(())": _*) pipe parse(parens) stripW // => Process(3, 1, 2, 0) ``` T
